videos.description: Kizaru (Borsalino) is a Marine Admiral in the anime/manga One Piece, known for his "Unclear Justice" and his Glint-Glint Fruit powers, which let him control and transform into light. He is characterized by a lazy, laid-back demeanor that contrasts with his immense speed and power, often following orders without question as a "cog in the machine". The name "Kizaru" also refers to a Russian rapper, Oleg Nechiporenko, who is a founder of the group "Haunted Family".               #onepiece #kizaru #fyp #luffy #gear5

videos.author: @blindredsamurai
videos.description: In the Egghead arc Admiral Kizaru has one of the most emotional arcs due to his history with Vegapunk. Their friendship is tested on Egghead ultimately culminating in Kizaru dealing the fatal blow to Vegapunk under World Government orders. Here Kizaru uses his Yasakani no Magatama to split his body into light particles and instantly return to the Labophase to come face to to face with Luffy in Gear 5 #onepiece #kizaru #luffy
